items.html: And therefore it said 'they shall shine' — they shall shine to others, for they take and give Mayin Dechurin and Mayin Nukvin. And this is like the example of the Yesod, which has these two aspects, in the secret of Yosef the Righteous and Binyamin the Righteous: this one is Mayin Dechurin, and that one is Mayin Nukvin. And of these two aspects, one is called radiance and the other is called sparkle. And this is what is said in the Zohar: 'the radiance and sparkle of the river that goes out of Eden,' which is the secret of the Yesod, called 'the river that goes out of Eden.'
